purpose: Dated, source-linked research for Hotspawn CS2 fixtures the published ladder leaves as a research model (no external betting line). HLTV is tried first for identity, then the Smarkets exchange, bo3.gg (which relays Thunderpick prices) and the esportsbook/aggregator surfaces.
policy: Evidence only. A joined bo3.gg row is a lead, not a pick: this script writes no probability, no pick and no alias. Only a two-sided, active, prematch bookmaker quote is recorded as a lead, copied verbatim. Smarkets raw 1/10000 quotes are copied verbatim and never divided out here. An HTTP 200 on a book landing page is never treated as a price.
